backend.lint: dbt parse --profiles-dir . && python3 -m py_compile ingestion/*.py scripts/milan/*.py

frontend.build: python3 ingestion/load_milan.py && dbt run --profiles-dir . --select source:raw_milan+ && cd scripts/milan/map && python3 prepare_main_data.py && python3 prepare_exposure_data.py && python3 prepare_wait_data.py && python3 render_building_backdrop.py && python3 build_map.py
frontend.test: for f in index.html data/main.json data/exposure.json data/wait_time.json vendor/deck.gl-9.4.0.min.js; do test -s scripts/milan/map/dist/site/$f || { echo "manca o vuoto: $f"; exit 1; }; done && test -s scripts/milan/map/dist/milan_heat_map.html && for p in $(grep -oE "__[A-Z_]+__" scripts/milan/map/template.html | sort -u); do for h in scripts/milan/map/dist/site/index.html scripts/milan/map/dist/milan_heat_map.html; do if grep -qF "$p" "$h"; then echo "segnaposto non sostituito: $p in $h"; exit 1; fi; done; done
